e.title: 再保条约情报：把历史条约、对手方草稿与法务标准语言三者并排比出差异
e.title_en: Reinsurance treaty intelligence: comparing historical treaties, counterparty drafts and Legal standard language side by side
e.title_hk: 再保條約情報：把歷史條約、對手方草稿與法務標準語言三者並排比出差異
e.summary: 一个跨再保续转期做条约合同分析的本地 Web 应用：把历史已签条约、对手方草稿与法务当前提供的标准语言放在一起比对，把合同措辞差异挑出来供谈判使用；其助手只引用所选文件的条款与页码出处，把抽取与解释分开，从不确定唯一正确措辞、不作法律结论、也不声称法律批准
e.summary_hk: 一個跨再保續轉期做條約合同分析的本地 Web 應用：把歷史已簽條約、對手方草稿與法務當前提供的標準語言放在一起比對，把合同措辭差異挑出來供談判使用；其助手只引用所選文件的條款與頁碼出處，把抽取與解釋分開，從不確定唯一正確措辭、不作法律結論、也不聲稱法律批准
e.summary_en: A local web application for treaty-contract analysis across reinsurance renewals: it puts historical executed treaties, counterparty drafts and Legal’s current standard language side by side to surface contractual wording variations for negotiation; its assistant cites only document, clause and page provenance from the selected files, separates extraction from interpretation, and never selects the single correct wording, makes legal conclusions or claims legal approval
e.body:
**reinsurance-treaty-intelligence** 是一个**跨再保续转期做条约合同分析的本地 Web 应用**（仓库 `chae-won-lee/reinsurance-treaty-intelligence`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 46 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**、**无描述**、**无 topics**——**故本条目依据 README 全文（3,885 字节）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「交接处——一个东西换手时会发生什么」**中的**第四种：谈判桌上同时摆着三个版本**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「Reinsurance Treaty Intelligence」**；⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「A complete local web application for **treaty-contract analysis across reinsurance renewals**. The immediate pilot focuses on **upcoming January Property renewals**, comparing **historical treaties against counterparty drafts and current Legal-supplied standard language** to surface **contractual variations for negotiation**.」**——**即「一个用于**跨再保续转期的条约合同分析**的完整本地 Web 应用。当前试点聚焦**即将到来的 1 月财产险续转**，把**历史条约与对手方草稿、以及法务当前提供的标准语言**相比对，以挑出**供谈判用的合同措辞差异**」**；**紧接着一句逐字**：**「**General Aviation remains included as a secondary illustrative line.**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其「安全边界（Safety Boundary）」一节逐字，是本条目在治理上最值得引用的一处**：**「The assistant is **grounded only in selected documents and seeded knowledge**. It **cites document, clause, and page provenance**. It can summarize extracted differences, explain why a deviation may matter for negotiation, and rank review issues, but it **never selects the single correct wording, makes legal conclusions, or claims legal approval**.」**——**即助手**只以所选文件与内置知识为依据**，**给出文件、条款与页码**三级的出处**，**可以**汇总已抽取的差异、解释某处偏离为何对谈判可能重要、并对复审问题排优先级****，**但**从不选定唯一正确措辞、不作法律结论、也不声称法律批准****。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「三方并排（历史条约 ／ 对手方草稿 ／ 法务标准语言）」是本条目最有价值的设计，也是本轮主题最贴切的一个样本**——**它把谈判桌上**实际同时存在的三个版本**结构化成一个可比对象**：**已签的历史版本（基线）、对方发来的草稿（待审）、法务当前的标准语言（内部标尺）****；**对做再保或合同工作的学生，这直接对应**续转期真实的工作形态**：**不是「读一份合同」，而是「判断这一版与上一版、以及与我方标准语言相比改了什么」**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该比对能替代法务或再保合约人员的专业判断**——**其自身「安全边界」即明确不选定唯一正确措辞**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「把抽取与解释分开」是本条目在方法上最值得记的一点**——**其 Walkthrough 4 逐字描述助手的回答**：**「The answer **cites exact document, clause, and page**, **separates extraction from interpretation**, and **does not determine the single correct language**.」**——**即答案**先给出文件／条款／页面的确切出处（抽取）**，**再把解释分开（解释）**，**且**不判定唯一正确措辞****。⭐⭐ **这是本站同一条纪律的第 10 次出现**（**[[powmcp-skills]]（319）→ [[rag-assurance]]（321）→ [[underwriting-decision-safety]]（323）→ [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]（325）→ [[sharia-compliance-agent]] 的 `NEEDS_REVIEW`（327）→ [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的缺陷清单（328）→ [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 grounding 逐字段标记（329）→ **本条（329）****）；**本条的新意在于**把「抽取」与「解释」的分离写成了回答的结构要求****——**即不只是**结论要附出处**，**而是**出处与推论必须是回答里两段不同的东西****（**可与第 321 轮 [[rag-assurance]] 并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「从不选定唯一正确措辞」是一条明确的**能力边界声明**，且与 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 flagging 形成对照**——**同为再保条约工具，两者都拒绝给出**唯一答案****：**一个**逐字段标记可疑**，**一个**拒绝在措辞上裁决****；**对受监管的合同工作，这是一种**刻意的克制****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该边界在实现中不可绕过**——**本次未读其 `src/` 实现**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「全部种子文件均为虚构、仅供工作流演示，本应用中任何内容都不是法律意见或法律批准」是第二处免责声明**——**逐字**：**「All seed documents are **fictional and for workflow demonstration only**. **Nothing in this app is legal advice or legal approval.**」**；**它同时出现在开篇段与 Requirements 之后**；**对做法律或合规相关工具的学生，这是一条**必须写清、且不能含糊**的边界**（**可与本会话对**不可核实内容一律标注**的做法同源**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **知识产权自律值得单独记一笔**——**逐字**：**「The interface is inspired by modern professional legal-document-review workflows: persistent comparison context, document-centric navigation, dense evidence tables, and a restrained enterprise palette. **It does not use Litera assets, trademarks, proprietary copy, or exact layouts.**」**——**即在说明**界面风格取自何类工作流**的同时，**明确声明未使用某商业法律文档审阅产品的资产、商标、专有文案或精确版式****；**对本会话反复处理的**来源与授权**问题，这是一个正面样本**（**⚠️ 本次未核实 Litera 是否为该商业产品的权利人，也未核实其声明是否准确**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「可选 `pdftotext`，缺它时记录明确的 OCR／抽取回退状态」是一个务实的降级设计**——**逐字**：**「Optional: `pdftotext` for richer local PDF extraction. **Without it, the ingestion pipeline records a clear OCR/extraction fallback status.**」**；**且「不需要外部密钥或付费服务即可运行核心演示」**——**即可复现性不依赖任何账号**（**⚠️ 本次未按其 Quick Start 运行**：`npm run setup` 与 `npm run dev`，界面在 `http://127.0.0.1:4173`）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **7 条 Walkthrough 把使用方式写得很具体，逐字实测**，**其中数条值得注意**：**① January Property triage**——在 Repository 标签里搜 `data privacy`，**再按 Line of Business 过滤 `Property`、按 Stage 过滤 `counterparty redline`**；**② Renewal comparison**——**以 2025 已签财产险条约为基线、以 2026 年 1 月对手方草稿为待审**，**注意「persistent selected pair、clause diff highlights 与 discrepancy grid」**；**③ Current standard context**——在 Compare 中选 2026 年法务当前标准，**复审 `data privacy`、`notice`、`hours aggregation` 与 `dispute-resolution` 四处偏离**；**⑤ Decision ledger**——在 Review Queue 里就地更新某项状态／处置，**「Refreshing reseeds from the database state; persistent ledger writes are available through the API」**（**即界面上的改动在刷新后会从数据库状态重新播种，持久写入需走 API**——**这是一处**把界面状态与持久状态分开**的诚实说明**）；**⑥ Ingestion**——把 `.txt`／`.docx`／`.pdf` 放入 `examples/ingest` 后跑 `npm run ingest`，**「TXT 与 DOCX 本地抽取；PDF 在有 `pdftotext` 时用其，否则记录一个 OCR 适配器回退」**（**⚠️ 本次未执行任何一条**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「General Aviation 作为次要示例业务线」这一句必须**极其谨慎地标注****——**本站第 327 轮已确立**航空险（aviation insurance）在 GitHub 上属结构性缺席**（**在 topic、关键词与 `in:readme` 三种搜索形状下均为 0 或纯噪声**）。⭐⭐ **本条目**并不推翻该结论，反而与分析一致**：**这里出现的「General Aviation」是**一条业务线标签**，用于在同一套条约比对流程上展示第二条线（Walkthrough 7 逐字为切换到 General Aviation 的 2025 基线、2026 对手方草稿与 2025 GA 法务标准）**，**而不是任何**航空险本身的承保、定价或监管资料****；**本词条据此**不把航空险计入已覆盖，也不主张该空白被填补****。**⑨ ⭐ **仓库结构逐字实测**：`server.py`（本地 HTTP 服务与 SQLite API）、`db/schema.sql`（SQLite 模式与索引）、`db/seed.json`（**虚构的条约、标准、条款、比对与台账种子数据**）、`scripts/seed.py`、`scripts/ingest.py`（本地摄取与条款切分流水线）、`public/`、`src/`（共享的仓储、比对与助手逻辑）、**`docs/architecture.md`（领域模型、流水线、grounding、安全与评测说明）**、`tests/`。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站再保与合同条目并读**：[[reinsurance-treaty-agent]]（**本批同轮的另一种读法：那一款把一份条约抽成结构化条款，本款把三个版本比出差异**）、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[clauseguard]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[acord]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**、**无描述**、**无 topics****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、修改或再分发其代码与种子数据前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据与 README 全文（3,885 字节）的定位段、General Aviation 一句、安全边界一节、免责声明、界面风格与知识产权声明、Requirements、Quick Start、Commands、7 条 Walkthrough 与仓库结构**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行 `npm run setup`／`seed`／`ingest`／`test`／`build`／`dev`、未打开其界面、未读 `docs/architecture.md`、未读 `src/` 与 `scripts/` 任何源码、未读 `db/seed.json`、未查看任何条款差异或助手回答****，因此**不能转述其领域模型、条款切分算法、grounding 实现、助手提示词、评测方法或任何具体条款的比对结果**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「助手把抽取与解释分开、不判定唯一正确措辞」是**README 的自述**，**本次未运行、未查看任何一条助手回答**；**本词条**不主张**该边界在实现中确实成立或不可绕过**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其 grounding 是否真能限制助手只依据所选文件**——**「grounded only in selected documents」是**设计主张****；**检索增强系统能否被诱导越出所选文本，本次未测**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其条款切分与差异识别的准确性**（**这是此类工具的核心能力，本次完全未评估**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「General Aviation」示例所涉内容的真实性或充分性**——**本词条据此**明确不把航空险计入已覆盖，也不主张该空白被填补****（**与第 327 轮结论一致而非相悖**）；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其界面风格声明（未使用 Litera 资产、商标、专有文案或精确版式）是否准确**，**亦未核实 Litera 与所述商业产品的关系**；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其「persistent ledger writes are available through the API」与界面刷新重播种之间的状态一致性问题**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **该工具处理的是**受法律约束的再保合同文本****；**其自身明确声明**不构成法律意见或法律批准****，**并**不选定唯一正确措辞****；**本词条**不主张**其输出可用于任何真实谈判、合同签署、法律判断或监管报送**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **全部种子文件均为虚构****——**README 明写**，**不主张**其可比对真实条约**；**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、仓库仅 46 KB、创建与推送同为 2026-09-08**——**体量小、极新、关注度极低**，**不主张其完整度、成熟度或已被采用**；**⑫ ⭐ **未核实** `README` 所称「complete local web application」的完整程度**；**⑬ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/chae-won-lee/reinsurance-treaty-intelligence` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 3,885 字节，定位段、安全边界、免责声明、Requirements、Commands、7 条 Walkthrough 与仓库结构逐字核对）；**未克隆、未安装、未运行任何命令、未打开其界面、未读 `docs/` 与任何源码**。

**reinsurance-treaty-intelligence** 是一個**跨再保續轉期做條約合同分析的本地 Web 應用**（倉庫 `chae-won-lee/reinsurance-treaty-intelligence`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 46 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-08**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`NONE`）**、**無描述**、**無 topics**——**故本條目依據 README 全文（3,885 位元組）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「交接處——一個東西換手時會發生什麼」**中的**第四種：談判桌上同時擺著三個版本**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：**標題逐字「Reinsurance Treaty Intelligence」**；⭐⭐⭐ **定位逐字**：**「A complete local web application for **treaty-contract analysis across reinsurance renewals**. The immediate pilot focuses on **upcoming January Property renewals**, comparing **historical treaties against counterparty drafts and current Legal-supplied standard language** to surface **contractual variations for negotiation**.」**；**緊接一句**：**「**General Aviation remains included as a secondary illustrative line.**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **「安全邊界（Safety Boundary）」一節逐字**：**「The assistant is **grounded only in selected documents and seeded knowledge**. It **cites document, clause, and page provenance**. It can summarize extracted differences, explain why a deviation may matter for negotiation, and rank review issues, but it **never selects the single correct wording, makes legal conclusions, or claims legal approval**.」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「三方並排（歷史條約／對手方草稿／法務標準語言）」是最有價值的設計，也是本輪主題最貼切的樣本**——**把談判桌上**實際同時存在的三個版本**結構化成可比對象**：**已簽的歷史版本（基線）、對方發來的草稿（待審）、法務當前的標準語言（內部標尺）****；**直接對應**續轉期真實的工作形態**：**不是「讀一份合同」，而是「判斷這一版與上一版、以及與我方標準語言相比改了什麼」**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「把抽取與解釋分開」是方法上最值得記的一點**——**Walkthrough 4 逐字**：**「The answer **cites exact document, clause, and page**, **separates extraction from interpretation**, and **does not determine the single correct language**.」**⭐⭐ **這是本站同一條紀律的第 10 次出現**（319 [[powmcp-skills]] → 321 [[rag-assurance]] → 323 [[underwriting-decision-safety]] → 325 [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]] → 327 [[sharia-compliance-agent]] 的 `NEEDS_REVIEW` → 328 [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的缺陷清單 → 329 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的逐欄位 grounding → **本條**）；**本條新意在於把「抽取」與「解釋」的分离寫成回答的結構要求**——**不只是**結論要附出處**，**而是**出處與推論必須是回答裡兩段不同的東西****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「從不選定唯一正確措辭」是明確的**能力邊界聲明**，與 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的標記形成對照**——**同為再保條約工具，兩者都拒絕給出**唯一答案****（**⚠️ 不主張**該邊界在實現中不可繞過**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「全部種子檔案均為虛構、僅供工作流演示，本應用中任何內容都不是法律意見或法律批准」逐字**：**「All seed documents are **fictional and for workflow demonstration only**. **Nothing in this app is legal advice or legal approval.**」**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **知識產權自律值得單獨記**——**逐字**：**「The interface is inspired by modern professional legal-document-review workflows: persistent comparison context, document-centric navigation, dense evidence tables, and a restrained enterprise palette. **It does not use Litera assets, trademarks, proprietary copy, or exact layouts.**」**（**⚠️ 未核實其聲明是否準確**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「可選 `pdftotext`，缺它時記錄明確的 OCR／抽取回退狀態」**，**且「不需要外部密鑰或付費服務」**（**⚠️ 未按其 Quick Start 運行**：`npm run setup`／`npm run dev`，介面在 `http://127.0.0.1:4173`）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **7 條 Walkthrough 逐字實測**，其中 **③** 複審 `data privacy`、`notice`、`hours aggregation`、`dispute-resolution` 四處偏離；**⑤** **「Refreshing reseeds from the database state; **reinsurance-treaty-intelligence** is **a local web application for treaty-contract analysis across reinsurance renewals** (repository `chae-won-lee/reinsurance-treaty-intelligence`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 46 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-08** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`), no description and no topics** — **so this entry rests on the full 3,885-byte README**. It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **the handoff point**: **three versions sitting on the negotiation table at once**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): the **title reads verbatim "Reinsurance Treaty Intelligence"**; ⭐⭐⭐ **its positioning, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"A complete local web application for treaty-contract analysis across reinsurance renewals. The immediate pilot focuses on upcoming January Property renewals, comparing historical treaties against counterparty drafts and current Legal-supplied standard language to surface contractual variations for negotiation."** — **comparing historical treaties against counterparty drafts and against Legal’s current standard language, to surface wording variations for negotiation**; **immediately followed by**: **"General Aviation remains included as a secondary illustrative line."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Its "Safety Boundary" section, read verbatim, is the entry’s most quotable governance passage**: **"The assistant is grounded only in selected documents and seeded knowledge. It cites document, clause, and page provenance. It can summarize extracted differences, explain why a deviation may matter for negotiation, and rank review issues, but it never selects the single correct wording, makes legal conclusions, or claims legal approval."** — **provenance down to document, clause and page, while never selecting the single correct wording, making legal conclusions or claiming legal approval**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Three versions side by side — historical treaty, counterparty draft and Legal standard language — is the entry’s most valuable design and the round’s most apt sample** — **it turns the three versions genuinely present at the negotiating table into a structured comparable object**: **the executed historical version as baseline, the counterparty draft as the item under review, and Legal’s current standard as the internal yardstick**; **for students of reinsurance or contracts this matches the real shape of renewal work: not reading one contract, but judging what this version changed against the last one and against our own standard language** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the comparison replaces legal or reinsurance-contract expertise — its own Safety Boundary declines to select the single correct wording**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Separating extraction from interpretation is the entry’s most notable methodological point** — **walkthrough 4 reads verbatim**: **"The answer cites exact document, clause, and page, separates extraction from interpretation, and does not determine the single correct language."** — **provenance first, interpretation in a separate part, and no verdict on the one correct wording**. ⭐⭐ **This is the tenth occurrence of this site’s recurring discipline** (**319 [[powmcp-skills]] → 321 [[rag-assurance]] → 323 [[underwriting-decision-safety]] → 325 [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]] → `NEEDS_REVIEW` in 327’s [[sharia-compliance-agent]] → the defect list in 328’s [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] → per-field grounding in 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] → this entry**); **what is new here is that the separation of extraction from interpretation is written as a structural requirement on the answer** — **not merely that a conclusion carries provenance, but that provenance and inference must be two distinct parts of the reply** (**readable with round 321’s [[rag-assurance]]**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Never selecting the single correct wording is an explicit statement of capability boundary, and it pairs with the flagging in [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]]** — **both are reinsurance treaty tools and both refuse a single answer**: **one flags suspect fields, the other declines to adjudicate wording**; **for regulated contract work that is deliberate restraint** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the boundary is unbypassable in the implementation — its `src/` was not read**). **④ ⭐⭐ The statement that all seed documents are fictional and for workflow demonstration only, and that nothing in the app is legal advice or legal approval, is a second disclaimer** — verbatim: **"All seed documents are fictional and for workflow demonstration only. Nothing in this app is legal advice or legal approval."**; **it appears both in the opening and after the requirements** (**the same instinct as this session’s practice of labelling everything unverifiable**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its intellectual-property discipline deserves separate note** — verbatim: **"The interface is inspired by modern professional legal-document-review workflows: persistent comparison context, document-centric navigation, dense evidence tables, and a restrained enterprise palette. It does not use Litera assets, trademarks, proprietary copy, or exact layouts."** — **naming the class of workflow its interface draws on while stating that it uses none of a commercial legal-review product’s assets, trademarks, proprietary copy or exact layouts**; **a positive sample for the sourcing-and-authorisation questions this session keeps handling** (**⚠️ whether Litera is the rights holder of that commercial product, and whether the statement is accurate, was not verified**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Optional `pdftotext` with an explicit OCR fallback status when absent is a practical degradation design** — verbatim: **"Optional: `pdftotext` for richer local PDF extraction. Without it, the ingestion pipeline records a clear OCR/extraction fallback status."**; **and the core demo needs no external secrets or paid services**, **so reproducibility depends on no account** (**⚠️ its Quick Start was not run: `npm run setup` and `npm run dev`, serving on `http://127.0.0.1:4173`**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Seven walkthroughs make usage concrete, read verbatim**, several worth noting: **① January Property triage** — search `data privacy` in the Repository tab, then filter Line of Business to `Property` and Stage to `counterparty redline`; **② Renewal comparison** — the 2025 executed Property treaty as baseline against the January 2026 counterparty draft, noting the persistent selected pair, clause diff highlights and discrepancy grid; **③ Current standard context** — selecting the 2026 Legal standard to review deviations in `data privacy`, `notice`, `hours aggregation` and `dispute-resolution`; **⑤ Decision ledger** — updating an item status locally in the Review Queue, where **"Refreshing reseeds from the database state; persistent ledger writes are available through the API"**, **an honest separation of interface state from persistent state**; **⑥ Ingestion** — dropping `.txt`, `.docx` or `.pdf` into `examples/ingest` and running `npm run ingest`, where **TXT and DOCX extract locally while PDF uses `pdftotext` when available and otherwise records an OCR-adapter fallback** (**⚠️ none of these was executed**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ The sentence about General Aviation as a secondary illustrative line must be annotated with great care** — **round 327 established that aviation insurance is structurally absent from GitHub (zero or pure noise across topic, keyword and `in:readme` searches)**. ⭐⭐ **This entry does not overturn that conclusion; it is consistent with it**: **the General Aviation here is a line-of-business label used to show the same treaty-comparison workflow on a second line** (**walkthrough 7 switches Compare to the General Aviation 2025 baseline, 2026 counterparty draft and 2025 GA legal standard**), **not any underwriting, pricing or regulatory material about aviation insurance itself**; **so the entry does not count aviation as covered and does not claim the gap has been filled**. **⑨ ⭐ Its repository layout reads verbatim**: `server.py` (local HTTP server and SQLite API), `db/schema.sql` (schema and indexes), `db/seed.json` (**fictional treaty, standard, clause, comparison and ledger seed data**), `scripts/seed.py`, `scripts/ingest.py` (local ingestion and clause segmentation), `public/`, `src/` (shared repository, comparison and assistant logic), **`docs/architecture.md` (domain model, pipeline, grounding, safety and evaluation notes)** and `tests/`. **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the corpus’s reinsurance and contract entries**: [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] (**this round’s other reading of the same material — that one extracts one treaty into structured terms, this one compares three versions for differences**), [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]], [[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]], [[clauseguard]], [[clausegraph]], [[policy-explainer-ai]] and [[acord]].

**②** this check verified **the repository metadata and the README’s full 3,885 bytes in respect of its positioning, the General Aviation sentence, the Safety Boundary section, the disclaimers, the interface and IP statement, requirements, quick start, commands, all seven walkthroughs and the repository layout**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run any npm command, open its interface, read `docs/architecture.md`, read any source in `src/` or `scripts/`, read `db/seed.json`, or view any clause difference or assistant answer**, so **its domain model, clause segmentation algorithm, grounding implementation, assistant prompts, evaluation method and any concrete clause comparison cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ That the assistant separates extraction from interpretation and does not determine the single correct wording is the README’s own account, and no assistant answer was run or viewed**; **the entry does not claim that boundary holds or is unbypassable in the implementation**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its grounding really confines the assistant to the selected documents was not verified** — **"grounded only in selected documents" is a design claim**; **whether a retrieval-augmented system can be induced to leave the selected text was not tested**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ The accuracy of its clause segmentation and difference identification was not verified** (**the core capability of such a tool, entirely unassessed here**); **⑥ ⭐⭐ The truth or sufficiency of the content behind the General Aviation example was not verified** — **so the entry explicitly does not count aviation as covered and does not claim the gap has been filled** (**consistent with, not contrary to, round 327’s conclusion**); **⑦ ⭐⭐ Whether its interface-style statement (no Litera assets, trademarks, proprietary copy or exact layouts) is accurate was not verified**, **nor was Litera’s relationship to the commercial product described**; **⑧ ⭐ Whether persistent API writes and the interface’s reseed-on-refresh are consistent was not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ The tool processes legally binding reinsurance contract text**; **it states itself that it is not legal advice or legal approval and that it does not select the single correct wording**; **the entry does not claim its output is usable for any real negotiation, contract execution, legal judgement or supervisory filing**; **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ All seed documents are fictional**, **as the README states**, **so it is not claimed to compare real treaties**; **⑪ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, a 46 KB repository created and pushed the same day (2026-09-08)**, **attention is very low**, **so no completeness, maturity or adoption is claimed**; **⑫ ⭐ How "complete" the README’s "complete local web application" really is was not verified**;
